purpose: population adaptation under original E1 conditions, not replication of the external finite-sample tables
radius_selection: fixed before new comparison outcomes; three equally spaced radii spanning the original E1 h1/h2 interval; no tuning
ms_kernel: hard ball indicator; original Gaussian-reduced polynomial-kernel engine with power=0
reference_distribution: fixed noisy population; never move/re-estimate latent reference nodes
initialization: same original noiseless E1 base queries; all three branches start from the identical point
scope_note: controlled known-geometry quadrature and evaluation, not blind manifold acquisition
common_horizon: all three branches and all queries in each cell are advanced to the same accepted horizon
population_stopping_note: replace external empirical mean-movement default1e-3 with original E1 residual precision; not the original Newton solver
global_budget_basis: minimum original STSP/DR production Multi error, including average and maximum
write_boundary: this isolated directory only; original simulation_experiments and paper_data are read-only
